summary: Refactored T1/T2/T4 bridge builders to return AppraisalOutput via an AppraisalInput intermediate, added appraisal_output_to_signal conversion helper, wired simulate_day_bridged through the new boundary, and created 37 new tests verifying the boundary contract.
diff_summary: tick_bridge.py: added imports for AppraisalInput, AppraisalOutput, EventCategory, RelationshipType; refactored build_signal_from_t1_world_tick to construct AppraisalInput intermediate and return AppraisalOutput; refactored build_signal_from_t2_influencer_tick similarly with populated relational_context; refactored build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick to return Optional[AppraisalOutput] with early None return before AppraisalInput construction when no relationship found; added appraisal_output_to_signal() conversion helper; updated simulate_day_bridged to wire builder -> AppraisalOutput -> appraisal_output_to_signal -> AppraisalSignal -> _apply_bridge_signal for T1, T2, and T4. test_p29_t4_bridge_boundary.py: 37 new tests covering return type assertions, boundary metadata (fallback_used, confidence), tick_type echo, conversion fidelity, and signal value parity for all T1/T2/T4 paths.
notes: All three builders now construct AppraisalInput as intermediate boundary object before producing AppraisalOutput.
T2 builder uses a synthetic RelationalContextSlice placeholder when no influencer relationship exists (required by AppraisalInput validation for social_interaction tick type).
T4 builder returns None early before constructing AppraisalInput when no relationship is found, per acceptance criteria.
The _adjust_t1, _adjust_t2, _adjust_t4 residual adjustment functions continue to operate on AppraisalSignal as before — no changes to those functions.
Advisory fields (narrative_summary, confidence, tick_type, fallback_used) on AppraisalOutput are not carried into the converted AppraisalSignal, as intended.
SocialEventIntensity.medium does not exist — valid values are low/moderate/high; test corrected to use moderate.
